functions.description: Partially modify a ticket class's name, description, pricing, inventory association, quantity or visibility.

cost.description: New complete face-value currency/amount pair; omitted preserves cost.

currency.description: Currency code for the new amount.

minorUnits.description: Exact nonnegative integer amount in currency minor units; not a floating-point major-unit amount.

name.description: New display name.

description.description: New description; empty explicitly clears it.

quantityTotal.description: New configured total ticket quantity, subject to sold-inventory constraints.

inventoryTierId.description: New inventory-tier association; omitted retains the current tier.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields remain unchanged and null is not a clearing instruction.

FunctionInput_eventbrite_updateticketcla.description: Identify a ticket class and supply only the fields to change.

updated.description: True after a successful update acknowledgment.

FunctionOutput_eventbrite_updateticketcl.description: Identity of the ticket class whose update was acknowledged.

tags.instructions: Find IDs with `list-ticket-classes` and inspect the class with `get-ticket-class`. Submit only changes. Tiered events require an inventory tier; unchanged tier association is preserved internally. This can change prices, quantity and visibility of an existing class. Do not assume a replay has no secondary effects.

functions.name: update-ticket-class-ticket-groups
functions.description: Set the ticket-group associations for one ticket class within an organization. An empty group list removes the class from every ticket group owned by that organization.

eventId.description: Identifier of the event owning the ticket class.

ticketClassId.description: Identifier of the ticket class whose group associations are updated.

organizationId.description: Organization owning the ticket groups whose associations are changed.

items.description: Identifier of a ticket group owned by the selected organization.

ticketGroupIds.description: Desired complete set of group identifiers within the organization. [] removes all organization-owned group associations; omission and null are not accepted. The 300-item tool bound is provisional.

FunctionInput_eventbrite_updateticketcla.description: Organization, owning event, ticket class, and requested ticket-group associations.

eventId.description: Owning event identifier used for the request.

accepted.description: The provider returned success for the association request; does not claim atomicity or per-group verification.

ticketClassId.description: Ticket class identifier used for the request.

organizationId.description: Organization scope of the accepted association request.

items.description: Ticket group identifier submitted in the accepted request.

requestedTicketGroupIds.description: Group identifiers submitted in the accepted request; not independently verified per-group outcomes.

FunctionOutput_eventbrite_updateticketcl.description: Acknowledgment of the native association request, without per-group verification.

tags.instructions: Supply the organization, owning event and ticket-class IDs, plus the desired complete group list from `list-ticket-groups`. This is an association change, not ticket-class deletion. Include every group you intend to retain; [] explicitly removes all of this organization's group associations. Maximum 300 groups per call. The result acknowledges the request, not individual group outcomes.

functions.name: update-ticket-group
functions.description: Rename an existing ticket group without intentionally changing its lifecycle or membership.

name.description: Replacement display name as ordinary Unicode text; null and empty names are not accepted.

ticketGroupId.description: Opaque identifier of the ticket group to rename.

FunctionInput_eventbrite_updateticketgro.description: The existing ticket group and its replacement display name.

id.description: Identifier of the updated ticket group; identity is unchanged.

name.description: Resulting group display name.

status.description: Provider lifecycle status, if returned.

organizationId.description: Owning organization identifier, if returned.

functions.name: update-venue
functions.description: Partially update a venue's name, postal address, or coordinates while preserving unspecified details.

name.description: Replacement display name; omit to preserve it. Null and empty names are not accepted.

address.description: Partial postal-address changes; omitted subfields are preserved. Empty optional lines clear them; null is not accepted.

city.description: Replacement city or locality; cannot be cleared by this tool.

region.description: Replacement state/province/region; empty string clears it.

country.description: Replacement uppercase two-letter country code; cannot be cleared by this tool.

address1.description: Replacement first street-address line; cannot be cleared by this tool.

address2.description: Replacement second address line; empty string clears it.

postalCode.description: Replacement postal code as text; empty string clears it and leading zeros are preserved.

venueId.description: Opaque identifier of the venue to update.

latitude.description: Replacement latitude in decimal degrees; supply with longitude. Omit both to preserve coordinates.

longitude.description: Replacement longitude in decimal degrees; supply with latitude. Coordinate clearing is not exposed.

FunctionInput_eventbrite_updatevenue.description: Changes to one existing venue; unspecified name, postal-address fields, and coordinates are preserved.

id.description: Identifier of the updated venue, unchanged by the update.

name.description: Resulting venue name, if returned.

region.description: State, province or region, if returned.

address2.description: Second street-address line, if returned; may be empty.

postalCode.description: Postal code as text, preserving leading zeros, if returned.

latitude.description: Resulting latitude in decimal degrees, if returned.

longitude.description: Resulting longitude in decimal degrees, if returned.

organizationId.description: Owning organization identifier, if returned.

FunctionOutput_eventbrite_updatevenue.description: Provider-returned resulting attributes of the updated venue.

tags.instructions: Get the venue ID from `list-venues` or `get-venue`. Supply only fields to change; address is a field-by-field patch, not a replacement. Empty optional address strings clear those lines. Coordinates must be supplied together. This modifies the existing venue; it does not create a separate event venue.

functions.description: Verify a team password and return the team's authorization token when verification succeeds.

password.description: User-supplied team password; sent unchanged and never echoed.

FunctionInput_eventbrite_verifyeventteam.description: Event, protected team, and user-supplied password to verify once.

token.description: Sensitive opaque team token returned after successful verification; preserve exactly.

FunctionOutput_eventbrite_verifyeventtea.description: Verified team and its sensitive authorization token.
